description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity. It provides methods to set employee associations and retrieve various state names related to US tax exemptions, leveraging external services for geographic information.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmpUsTaxExemption entity providing additional methods for managing US tax exemption data and related geographic information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpUsTaxExemption instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the tax exemption record based on employee number.

methods.name: getTaxState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the state associated with the tax exemption, using external country service.

methods.name: getUnemploymentState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the unemployment state, using external country service.

methods.name: getWorkState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the work state, using external country service.
